## Data analysis

Descriptive data are presented as mean and standard deviation (SD). For inferential statistics, Bayesian models were constructed using the Stan probabilistic programming language [@stanpaper] and fitted using the `cmdstanr` interface [@cmdstanr] in R [@R]. All sampling from 
prior and posterior distributions were done using the Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) no-U-turn sampler ([Stan Reference Manual: MCMC sampling](https://mc-stan.org/docs/reference-manual/mcmc.html)). Performance of the HMC algorithm was assessed through chain convergence statistics (R-hat) and visually inspecting convergence and stationary sampling across multiple HMC chains. A general workflow was adopted where models were incrementally built and tested for validity through simulations. First, implications of prior distributions were evaluated using prior-predictive simulations. Priors were selected to constrain model predictions and parameter values to *a priori* plausible ranges. This approach encourages the use of weakly informative priors on model parameters, which regularize models and shrink estimates and predictions without distorting the data's influence on inference [@lemoine2019;@mcelreath2020;@gelman2014]. In relevant cases, synthetic data were used to confirm that model inferences were not biased by model misspecification. Samples from the joint posterior distribution were used to create posterior predictive checks, in which model implications are simulated and compared with characteristics of the observed data [@gelman2014, pp. 141]. Selected models were also assessed for inferential capabilities using synthetic data simulations where parameter values are known. The sensitivity of model specifications to inference was assessed by comparing predictions across different models.
 

## Description of the data set and participants

The overall objective of the present analysis is to determine the effect of N-3 supplementation in combination with resistance training on glucose metabolism and indicators of metabolic health. Outcome variables in the analysis are:

- Blood glucose in response to a oral glucose tolerance-test
- Metabolic syndrome (derived from sub-scores)
   * Triglycerides
   * Waist circumference
   * Blood pressure 
   * HDL Cholesterol
   * Resting glucose
- Body mass index
- Relative fat mass
- HOMA2-IR
- Adiponectin
- Whole blood fatty acid composition


```{r}

# Source figure options, packages, and main data prep.
source("./R/fig-opt-fun.R")
source("./R/packages.R")
source("./R/data-prep.R")
source("./R/helpers.R")

# Settings
refit.models <- FALSE

```



```{r}
#| label: data-prep-participants




part <- AOData::idkeys  
  
## Descriptives data 
baseline_dat <- AOData::bodycomp |>
  select(participant, time, lean.whole, BMC.whole, fat.whole)  |>
  mutate(weight = lean.whole + BMC.whole + fat.whole) |>
  inner_join(part) |>
  filter(time == "T1") |>
  ## Calculate height based on weight (DXA) and BMI 
  mutate(height = 100 * sqrt((weight/1000) / bmi)) |>
  ## Calculate relative lean and fat
  mutate(lean.rel = 100 * (lean.whole / weight), 
         fat.rel = 100 * (fat.whole/weight), 
         # Weight in kg
         weight = weight / 1000) |>
  select(participant, 
         treat, 
         completed, 
         sex, 
         age, 
         height, 
         weight, 
         bmi) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = age:bmi)
  
  
## Included participants 
total_participants <- baseline_dat |> 
  distinct(participant) |> 
  pull(participant)




# Per completed period
# dat |> 
#   summarise(.by = c(completed, treat, sex, name), 
#             m = mean(value), 
#             s = sd(value), 
#             min = min(value), 
#             max = max(value))
  
# Total

# Calculate n
n_total <- baseline_dat |> 
  filter(name == "age") |> 
  summarise(.by = c(treat, sex), 
            n = n()) 

n_male_omega <- n_total[1,3][[1]]
n_female_omega <- n_total[3,3][[1]]
n_male_ctrl <-  n_total[2,3][[1]]
n_female_ctrl <-  n_total[4,3][[1]]

N <- sum(n_total$n)
```

A total of `r N` participants are included in the data analysis. Participants were randomized into two groups, an active treatment-group (N-3 fatty acids, 1 mg day^-1^) and a placebo control group (Placebo; @tbl-participants).



```{r}
#| label: tbl-participants
#| tbl-cap: "Participant characteristics."


baseline_dat |> 
  summarise(.by = c(treat, sex, name), 
            m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            min = min(value), 
            max = max(value), 
            n = n()) |> 
  mutate(stats = paste0(
    sprintf("%.1f", round(m, 1)), 
    " (", 
    sprintf("%.1f", round(s, 1)), 
    ") [",
    sprintf("%.1f", round(min, 1)), 
    " - ", 
    sprintf("%.1f", round(max, 1)), 
    "]"), 
    n = n) |> 
  
  dplyr::select(treat, sex, name,n, stats) |> 
  

  
  dplyr::select(-n) |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
              values_from = stats) |> 
  
  mutate(sex = if_else(sex == "m", "Male", "Female"), 
         name = case_when(
           name == "age" ~ "Age (years)", 
           name == "height" ~ "Stature (cm)", 
           name == "weight" ~ "Body mass (kg)", 
           name == "bmi" ~ "Body mass index (kg&times;m^-2^)", 
           TRUE ~ NA )) |> 

  group_by(sex) |> 
  gt() |> 
  fmt_markdown() |> 
  
  cols_label(omega = md(paste0("N-3<br>(&male; n = ", 
                               n_male_omega, 
                               "; &female; n = ", 
                               n_female_omega, ")")),
             ctrl = md(paste0("Placebo<br>(&male; n = ", 
                              n_male_ctrl, 
                              "; &female; n = ",
                              n_female_ctrl, ")")), 
             sex = "", 
             name = "") |> 
  tab_footnote(footnote = "Data are presnted as Mean (SD) [Min-Max]")

```




```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-cap: "Participant recruitment, allocation and drop-out."


# Shared styling
main_box_gp <- grid::gpar(fill = adjustcolor(colscale[4], alpha = 0.2), col = colscale[4], lwd = 1.5)
group_box_gp <- grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = colscale[1], lwd = 1.5)
excl_box_gp  <- grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = colscale[3], lwd = 1.2)
drop_box_gp  <- grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = colscale[3], lwd = 1.2)
main_con_gp  <- grid::gpar(col = colscale[4], lwd = 1.5, fill = colscale[4])
excl_con_gp  <- grid::gpar(col = colscale[3], lwd = 1.2, fill = colscale[3])

grid::grid.newpage()
flowchart(
  source = boxGrob(glue::glue("Population Lillehammer municipaly \nn = {pop}", pop = txtInt(16896)),
                   box_gp = main_box_gp),
  eligible = boxGrob(glue::glue("Eligible\nn = {pop}", pop = txtInt(10032)),
                     box_gp = main_box_gp),
  included = boxGrob(glue::glue("Randomized\nn = {incl}", incl = txtInt(147)),
                     box_gp = main_box_gp),
  dropout = boxGrob(glue::glue("Drop-out\nn = {incl}", incl = txtInt(52)),
                     box_gp = main_box_gp),
  groups = list(
    boxGrob(glue::glue("Treatment A\nn = {n}", n = txtInt(43)),        box_gp = group_box_gp),
    boxGrob(glue::glue("Treatment B\nn = {n}", n = txtInt(122-43-30)), box_gp = group_box_gp)
  )) |>
  spread(axis = "y") |>
  spread(subelement = "groups", axis = "x") |>
  equalizeWidths(subelement = list("source", "eligible", "included", "dropout")) |>
  equalizeWidths(subelement = "groups") |>
  insert(list(excluded = boxHeaderGrob(
                header = glue::glue("Excluded (n = {tot}):", tot = 30),
                body   = glue::glue(" - not interested: {n1}\n - contra-indicated: {n2}",
                              n1 = 12, n2 = 18),
                bjust      = "left",
                box_gp     = excl_box_gp,
                header_gp  = grid::gpar(col = colscale[3], cex = 1))),
         after = "eligible",
         name  = "excluded") |>
  
    insert(list(dropout = boxHeaderGrob(
                header = glue::glue("Drop-out (n = {tot}):", tot = 14),
                body   = glue::glue(" - not interested: {n1}\n - contra-indicated: {n2}",
                              n1 = 12, n2 = 18),
                bjust      = "left",
                box_gp     = drop_box_gp,
                header_gp  = grid::gpar(col = colscale[3], cex = 1))),
         after = "included",
         name  = "dropout") |>
  
  
  move(subelement = "excluded", x = .8) |>
  move(subelement = "dropout", x = .8) |>
  connect("eligible", "excluded", type = "L",    lty_gp = excl_con_gp, arrow_size = 3,
          label = "Excluded") |>
    connect("included", "dropout", type = "L",    lty_gp = excl_con_gp, arrow_size = 3,
          label = "Drop-out") |>
  connect("source",   "eligible", type = "vert", lty_gp = main_con_gp, arrow_size = 3,
          smooth = TRUE) |>
  connect("eligible", "included", type = "vert", lty_gp = main_con_gp, arrow_size = 3,
          smooth = TRUE) |>
  connect("included", "groups",   type = "N",    lty_gp = main_con_gp, arrow_size = 3,
          smooth = TRUE)

```
